# activedirectory_ous (Data Source)

Search for organizational units under a container by scope and filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Search for organizational units under a container. A one_level scope lists the
# immediate children of the search base; subtree (the default) walks the whole
# tree beneath it.
data "activedirectory_ous" "top" {
  container = "DC=corp,DC=local"
  scope     = "one_level"
}

output "top_level_ou_dns" {
  value = [for o in data.activedirectory_ous.top.ous : o.dn]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `container` (String) SearchBase DN. Defaults to the domain root.
- `filter_by` (Map of String) Attribute equality terms, ANDed. Values are escaped for you.
- `ldap_filter` (String) Raw LDAP filter, ANDed with filter_by. You own its correctness.
- `max_results` (Number) Cap on results (default 1000). Exceeding it is an error, not truncation.
- `scope` (String) base, one_level, or subtree (default).

### Read-Only

- `ous` (Attributes List) Matching organizational units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ous))

<a id="nestedatt--ous"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ous`

Read-Only:

- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `dn` (String) The distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) The objectGUID.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `name` (String) The OU's name (RDN).
- `protected_from_accidental_deletion` (Boolean) Whether the OU is protected from accidental deletion.
